CustomField.description: This is a secondary threshold used for a three-tiered grade tracking system
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select a grade (0-100 scale) that this school defines as "On Track" or "Green." Any section grades that are above this number will display in the Gradebook UI as Green. Any number that falls between this and the Passing Grade threshold will be yellow.
CustomField.label: On Track Threshold
